messages:
deploy-bot: starting staged rollout v2.7.1 -> 5% traffic eu-west, 5% ap-south. change window 22:00-23:00 UTC
janet: seeing p95 latency spike in eu-west, ~120ms above baseline (small sample)
miguel: checking ingress logs now, seeing a cluster of connection retries from a couple gateways
sre-oncall: can we throttle eu-west to 0% and pin to v2.7.0 while triage happens?
owen: +1 to pin eu-west. let the rest of the rollout continue if safe
janet: quick A/B suggests a tokenizer-format change in v2.7.1, possible regresssion in prompt parsing
miguel: stack traces show tokenizer mismatch in the first stage, will open a ticket if confirmed
janet: @deploy-bot hold eu-west and pin to stable version — command below
```
redwoodctl rollout update --region eu-west --traffic 0
redwoodctl rollout pin --region eu-west --version v2.7.0 --reason "tokenizer regression suspected"
```
deploy-bot: executing: `redwoodctl rollout update --region eu-west --traffic 0`
deploy-bot: eu-west traffic set to 0% (op: tx-9832)
deploy-bot: executing: `redwoodctl rollout pin --region eu-west --version v2.7.0`
deploy-bot: pinned eu-west -> v2.7.0 (pin id: pin-1745) :white_check_mark:
sre-oncall: plan: pin now, run smoke tests in eu-west, if green keep pinned and schedule v2.7.1 patch; if fail, full rollback for eu-west and escalate
janet: starting smoke tests (quick inference + kv-cache sanity), ETA ~4m
devex: please add brief note to release notes: "EU canary reverted due to tokenizer regression; investigating"
owen: after smoke, if green, resume percent rollout for ap-south and other regions; keep eu-west pinned until patch release
miguel: filing INF-4321 with logs + repro snippet
janet: ack. change window still open ~18m. keeping eu-west pinned until patch or signoff from eng and SRE
deploy-bot: traffic resume for pinned regions requires manual `redwoodctl rollout resume` or explicit unpin
janet: thanks team — will update ticket and post follow-up once smoke completes
sre-oncall: marking this as a stop/go call for eu-west -> STOP (hold). continuing monitoring for other regions
janet: smoke tests passed locally, but will wait for canary infra checks before any resume
miguel: assigning to tokenizer owner for upstream fix, pinging @devex for any customer comms guidance
devex: noted, will draft a short blurb for release notes and support playbook
janet: end state: eu-west pinned to v2.7.0, rollout paused for eu-west, other regions remain at 5% unless we see signals. next: patch branch + new build, ETA 2-3 hours.
